Delhi CM Orders Safety Upgrades for DU North Campus

Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta has directed officials to install more streetlights and CCTV cameras on Delhi University's North Campus. The instructions also emphasized ensuring cleanliness, adequate lighting, and safe pathways within the campus area.
